## 🧪 Verification & Quality Checklist

Before submitting, please verify that you have completed all of the following steps:

- [ ] **Linked Issue:** This PR addresses an issue previously approved by the maintainer.
- [ ] **Typecheck:** `npx tsc --noEmit` passes cleanly with **0** errors.
- [ ] **Unit Tests:** `npm test` passes 100% of the test suite without failures.
- [ ] **New Tests Added:** I have included unit tests covering the new functionality or regression fix.
- [ ] **No Drive-By Changes:** No cosmetic reformatting, whitespace modifications, or unrelated file changes.
- [ ] **Dependencies:** No new external libraries or frameworks have been added without prior consensus.
- [ ] **Performance:** Canvas rendering remains performant and non-blocking (<40MB baseline RAM).
